profile.name: Vishalini E V
profile.title: M.Sc. Microbiology
profile.summary: Microbiology graduate with hands-on experience in microbiological techniques, molecular biology, laboratory research and quality control, gained through academic projects and internships. Completed a research project at the Food Technology Division, BARC, on phytosanitary treatment and shelf-life of fruits. Available to join immediately and seeking an entry-level role in microbiology, quality control, quality assurance, research, food, pharmaceutical or biotechnology.

projects.title: Use of electron beam for phytosanitary treatment and shelf life extension of guava fruit
projects.where: M.Sc. project, Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Mumbai
points: Studied the effect of electron beam irradiation on the quality, physiological characteristics and storage life of fresh guava.
Evaluated the combined impact of packaging materials and electron beam treatment on shelf life.
Assessed antibrowning agents for maintaining fruit quality during storage.
Monitored changes in microbial quality and post-harvest characteristics after treatment.
projects.note: Ongoing BARC project: publication needs consent from FTD, BARC.

projects.title: Antimicrobial activity of lemon grass and Java tea against soil pathogens
points: Investigated Cymbopogon citratus and Orthosiphon stamineus against soil-borne pathogens.
Prepared ethanolic and aqueous extracts and tested them by agar well diffusion.
Ethanolic extracts showed higher antimicrobial effectiveness.
Performed 16S rRNA sequencing to identify bacterial strains affected by the extracts.
